acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

The MS/MS acquisition was performed in data dependent mode (DDA) mode by fragmenting the 10 most intense ions in the collision-induced dissociation (CID) modality with a full scan in the 300 to 1800 m/z range.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Protein samples were first mixed with SDS (5%) and DTT (20 mM), boiled, cooled to room  temperature, and then alkylated with iodoacetamide (40 mM) in the dark for 30 min.
